scenario: Checkout API 5xx rate jumped from 0.2% to 8% at 14:05; users can't complete orders.
expected_root_cause: postgres-primary connection pool exhaustion causing checkout 5xx

scenario: Cart contents intermittently empty for ~15% of users since 09:40.
expected_root_cause: redis-cluster hitting maxmemory and evicting active cart keys

scenario: Payment capture jobs backing up; queue depth climbing since 11:10.
expected_root_cause: stripe-gateway upstream timeouts stalling payment captures

scenario: Search returns partial/empty results for many queries since 16:20.
expected_root_cause: elasticsearch unassigned shards degrading search results

scenario: Push notifications delayed 10-20 min; delivery lag alarms firing.
expected_root_cause: kafka-broker ISR shrink blocking notification produce/consume

scenario: Profile pages failing to load with auth errors for logged-in users since 13:00.
expected_root_cause: auth-service rejecting valid sessions (introspection failure)

scenario: Image uploads failing for ~30% of users since 10:05.
expected_root_cause: object-store returning 503/500 on PUT, failing uploads

scenario: Feed service can't reach several backends; broad connection failures since 15:30.
expected_root_cause: dns-resolver failing internal name resolution

scenario: Order history shows stale/missing recent orders since 12:40.
expected_root_cause: postgres-replica replication lag serving stale reads

scenario: Logins failing site-wide starting right after 02:00 key rotation.
expected_root_cause: token-service botched signing-key rotation invalidating JWTs

scenario: Analytics dashboards hours behind; ingestion lag growing since 08:00.
expected_root_cause: kafka-broker rebalance storm stalling analytics consumers

scenario: Inventory counts returning errors right after the 14:00 deploy.
expected_root_cause: regression in inventory-service v2.3.1 deploy (NullPointerException)

scenario: Recommendation API pods restarting in a loop since the 16:00 rollout.
expected_root_cause: recommendation-api memory leak / OOM after model rollout

scenario: Session service throwing 500s on startup after a config push at 11:45.
expected_root_cause: bad config push (sess.ttl_secs type) crashing session-service

scenario: Outbound webhooks delayed and retrying; some duplicates since 13:20.
expected_root_cause: postgres-primary lock contention on the webhook outbox table (redis rate-limiting is a symptom)

scenario: Ranking requests timing out; gateway showing 503s since 17:10.
expected_root_cause: object-store (feature store) read latency causing rec-ranker timeouts surfaced as envoy 503s

scenario: Autocomplete suggestions stale and slow since 18:00.
expected_root_cause: elasticsearch query slowdown driving cache misses in search-suggest

scenario: Profile photos failing to load; some users also report slow logins.
expected_root_cause: object-store GET errors/throttling breaking profile photo loads

scenario: Chat messages delayed; team also just finished a redis cache warm-up.
expected_root_cause: kafka-broker under-replicated partitions delaying chat message delivery

scenario: Invoices failing to finalize; stripe latency also slightly elevated.
expected_root_cause: ledger-service rejecting double-entry writes, blocking invoice finalization
